entries.58a86a4f8c877775: This business provides IT engineers, such as programmers and systems engineers, to customers to support their operations. Main tasks covered are program development, network construction and maintenance and operation work, and the company also provides operation and support services for large-scale core systems, mainly in the Greater Tokyo area. Orders are received under service provision contracts and under worker dispatch contracts based on the Worker Dispatch Act. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended May 2026 was ¥1,675 million.
entries.58db0fa7adfafd47: Through a proprietary training system of about six months, including on-the-job training (OJT), the company trains new graduates and people without IT industry experience into the IT engineers customers require and employs them, giving it a structure to stably supply a large number of IT engineers. In training, in addition to programming and networking technology, the company also develops human skills such as communication ability.
